newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes higher on talk of exports.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes higher on talk of exports.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed higher on talk of potential export business, traders said.

There was talk of possible business this week with India and Egypt but many traders remained skeptical of the amount of wheat that may be negotiated and noted the wheat business was for optional-origin.
Concerns about dry weather in the U.S. Great Plains also contributed to the advances, the traders said.
Mill pricing boosted the deferred months while farmer selling limited gains in the nearby months, they said.
MGE spring wheat futures closed 2-1/4 to four cents per bushel higher, with March up three at $3.89-3/4.
